# 0.5.13

## 本次更新

- 已登录冷启动时不再把有效的网页会话误判为未确认：会话探测会等待挑战页跳转完成后再判断，不会再出现推荐页空转。
- 登录成功后的推荐页只请求一次，不再重复加载第一页。
- 冷启动先显示上次的推荐内容，随后自动替换为最新推荐；缓存损坏或不可用时不影响正常加载。
- 下拉刷新与手动重试始终重新获取最新推荐。

## Changes (English)

- Stop misjudging a valid web session as unconfirmed on a logged-in cold start: the session probe now waits for the post-challenge navigation before deciding, so the recommendation feed no longer stalls.
- The recommendation feed requests its first page once after login instead of fetching it twice.
- Show the previous recommendations on a cold start, then replace them with the live result; a missing or corrupt cache never blocks loading.
- Pull-to-refresh and manual retry always request fresh recommendations.
